DIAGNOSIS: by LONGTINE,JANINA A.,M.D. 
1. SPECIMEN DESIGNATED "RIGHT BREAST TISSUE-SUPERIOR," EXCISION: 
INVASIVE DUCTAL CARCINOMA, (2.1cm ), poorly differentiated 
(Bloom-Richardson grade III/III). 
Invasive tumor extends to within 0.2cm of superficial margin 
(closest margin, block #6). 
Lymphatic/vascular invasion is not identified. 
DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN-SITU, extensive, solid and comedo types, 
high nuclear grade, in association with and away from invasive tumor. 
DCIS is present in twenty (20) of forty-three (43) blocks and 
comprises approximately 20% of invasive tumor. 
DCIS is within 0.1cm of superior (block #10), deep (block #26), 
superficial and medial (block #7) margins. 
LOBULAR CARCINOMA IN-SITU is focally present. 
Microcalcifcations associated with invasive tumor and in situ carcinoma. 
Repair reaction consistent with prior biopsy site. 
2. SPECIMEN DESIGNATED "RIGHT BREAST TISSUE-MEDIAL SHAVE MARGIN," EXCISION: 
Sclerosing adenosis. 
Fibroadenoma. 
Microcalcifications associated with benign ducts. 
3. SPECIMEN DESIGNATED "ANTERIOR SHAVE MARGIN," EXCISION: 
Benign breast tissue and associated microcalcifications. 
4. SPECIMEN DESIGNATED "LATERAL SHAVE MARGIN," EXCISION: 
Benign breast tissue and associated microcalcifications. 
5. SPECIMEN DESIGNATED "INFERIOR SHAVE MARGIN," EXCISION: 
Sclerosing adenosis. 
Microcalcifications associated with benign tissue. 
6. SPECIMEN DESIGNATED "POSTERIOR SHAVE MARGIN," EXCISION: 
DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN-SITU, cribriform type, intermediate nuclear 
grade, present within two (2) separate ductal-lobular units, 
each < 1mm (blocks #65, 76), including one (1) at the "new" 
resection margin. 
7. SPECIMEN DESIGNATED "NEW MEDIAL SHAVE MARGIN," EXCISION: 
Sclerosing adenosis. 
Microcalcifications associated with benign ducts. 
SURGICAL ADDENDUM: by LONGTINE,JANINA A.,M.D. 
Immunoperoxidase studies performed on paraffin sections of the invasive 
carcinoma confirm that the tumor cells are negative for Her2/neu. 
CLINICAL DATA: 
History: A 48 year old pre-menopausal female with a probable right breast 
mass demonstrated on US. Core biopsy 0n REMOVED_DATE showed invasive ductal 
carcinoma poorly differentiated and DCIS solid type (high nuclear grade) which 
is present within area of invasive carcinoma. Left breast calcifications. 
Operation: Right breast wire localized lumpectomy. 
TISSUE SUBMITTED: #1) Right breast tissue - superior 
(short suture/superior; long suture/lateral; whip stitch/ 
deep margin)
